title: National Jail Census, 1978
description:
The National Jail Census was conducted in early 1978 by the
 United States Census Bureau for the Bureau of Justice Statistics. The
 census was taken of all locally administered county and municipal
 jails with the authority to hold prisoners for more than 48 hours.
 Data are presented for jails in 45 states. Excluded are
 Connecticut, Delaware, Hawaii, Rhode Island, and Vermont. Information
 includes jail population by legal status, age and sex of prisoners,
 maximum sentence, admissions and releases, available services,
structure and capacity, expenditure, and employment.
